(data source schema)
    description: Coralogix View Folder. Folders group saved views in the Explore screen. For more info please review - https://coralogix.com/docs/user-guides/monitoring-and-insights/explore-screen/custom-views/.
id  tftypes.String optional
    description: Unique identifier for the view folder, assigned by Coralogix. Stays the same when the folder is renamed.
name  tftypes.String optional,computed
    description: Display name of the view folder. Between 1 and 100 characters - the backend silently truncates a longer name, so the provider rejects it instead. Folder names must currently be unique within the team.
